title: Reporting Periods under the New Home Builder Warranties
content:
Each program of Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties sets three reporting periods for the homeowner's claims, all counted in calendar days: the notice period after a defect is discovered, the grace period after a coverage phase ends, and the period after closing for reporting cosmetic surface defects (paint, finishes, scratches, chips).

## Periods by program

| Program | Claim must be filed within, after discovering the defect | A defect discovered during a phase may still be filed within, after that phase ends | Cosmetic surface defects must be reported within, after the closing date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 30 days | 30 days | 0 days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 30 days | 30 days | 60 days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 30 days | 30 days | 60 days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 30 days | 30 days | 60 days |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 30 days | 30 days | 60 days |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 30 days | 30 days | 90 days |

## Reading the periods

**Do the notice and grace periods differ between programs?** No. Every program sets 30 calendar days for each.

**Which program allows the longest period for cosmetic defects?** The Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty, at 90 calendar days after the closing date; the four 1-2-10 programs allow 60 calendar days, and the Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty sets 0 days.
